thread:
incbot: :rotating_light: Pager: GPU OOM surge on serving-cluster-3 during prefill. Multiple containers restarted in the last 3m. Severity: P1. Paging alex_oncall and eng-runtime.
alex_oncall: On it. Seeing repeated container restarts on node gke-infer-12. Logs show CUDA OOM then container exit.
maria_sre: Noted. Any customer-facing impact yet?
chris_runtime: Yes — we've got noisy long-context prefill requests hitting a few pods. Prefill memory spikes to ~48GB and then container dies with 'cudaErrorIllegalAddress' in dmesg.
alex_oncall: Reproduced locally on a dev pod with a long 1M-token-ish prompt? that's huge but a few customers have very long contexts.
chris_runtime: It's not token count exactly, looks like many concurrent long-prefill streams + KV cache growth. Hotpool thrashing. When KV cache grows we hit vram and mmap fails.
leo_eng: Quick mitigation idea: temporarily route requests with context > 64k tokens to the smaller-quantized variant and enable prefill throttling at the router.
alex_oncall: Agreed. Taking node out of rotation: kubectl cordon gke-infer-12 and scale down hotpool on that node.
chris_runtime: I'm pushing a runtime flag to trim prefills: --prefill-max-bytes=10000000 on the affected deployment. Will restart replica set.
sam_cs: I'll draft a short customer note. Which tenants are affected?
chris_runtime: Metrics show spike primarily for tenant_ids: 3745 and 9982. Both on Dedicated and Hosted fallback for a handful of requests.
alex_oncall: Rolling restart of the replica completed. Observability: error rate dropping but still see a steady stream of large prefill attempts.
maria_sre: Any permanent fix planned or just routing+throttle?
leo_eng: Longer term: enforce KV cache caps per-request + eviction policy and add a fast-fail path for prefill bytes > threshold. We'll also add a detection rule to route oversized requests to coldmodel.
chris_runtime: Filed runtime ticket INF-2319 to add per-request cache limits and automatic coldmodel fallback. ETA 2 weeks.
alex_oncall: For immediate relief I've added a temporary WAF rule to return 429 for prefill payloads > 8MB and enabled smaller-quant model routing for flagged requests.
sam_cs: Sending customer update: short note explaining we're mitigating and will follow up. Can someone confirm affected tenants list?
chris_runtime: Confirmed 3745, 9982 and a handful of anonymous hostnames. I'll attach logs to the ticket.
maria_sre: Will keep pager open until we see 30m stable. If restarts stop, we demote to P2 and close.
alex_oncall: Monitoring: memory usage trending down, no restarts in last 6m. Keeping cordon for 10m more.
sam_cs: Sent initial customer outreach to both tenants. I'll update if they reply.
leo_eng: :thumbsup: I'll triage the heap/kv cache growth traces tomorrow AM.
incbot: Incident update scheduled in 30m. If stable, change severity to P2.
alex_oncall: Thanks team. Marking handoff to morning rotation if stable.
